profile.headline: When I treat everyone with respect I earn the respect of others. Background includes entrepreneur, IT Management, Java Architecture and Development, public speaker and author.
profile.summary: I work very hard to further my reputation as "A joy to work with". I am an experienced development manager and mentor and encourage agile methodologies, simple design, industry best practices and positive reinforcement.
